selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the believers say when they saw Allah’s greatness, beauty, and glory shown in creation?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What words did they use to honor that greatness?
questions.answer: They used words declaring that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: When they felt needy, to whom did they turn?
questions.answer: They turned only to Allah.

questions.question: Give one way they praised Allah when seeing that artistry.
questions.answer: They spoke with amazement about the wonders Allah had willed.

questions.question: Why would they call people to come and hurry toward prayer and success?
questions.answer: Because they wanted others to witness the signs of Allah and respond with worship.

questions.question: Which short statement best sums up that obedience?
questions.answer: They heard and obeyed.

questions.question: How are the prescribed prayers described in the passage?
questions.answer: They are described as a summary of worship.

questions.question: What did the believers achieve by fulfilling their worship and life duties there?
questions.answer: They reached a noble human rank and became honored above other creatures.

questions.question: What reward did their Lord prepare for them after this test?
questions.answer: He prepared eternal happiness and the Home of Peace.

questions.question: What final hope does the passage leave with the reader?
questions.answer: It leaves the hope that Allah will include us among those blessed people.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the first part of this passage?
questions.answer: It shows how believers respond to Allah with worship, praise, obedience, and trust.

questions.question: What did their bowing and prostrating show about them?
questions.answer: It showed that they felt weak, needy, and humble before Allah.

questions.question: What do those movements show about how a servant should stand before Allah?
questions.answer: They show reverence, humility, and loving submission.

questions.question: How did they respond to those signs besides simply looking at them?
questions.answer: They praised, admired, and testified to faith.

questions.question: What invitation did they give to other people?
questions.answer: They called others to come, look, and hurry toward prayer and success.

questions.question: Why is the world compared to a huge mosque?
questions.answer: Because it is a place where believers carry out worship and the duties of life.

questions.question: What rank did they reach after doing their duties with faith, certainty, and trust?
questions.answer: They rose above other creatures and became trustworthy caretakers on the earth.

questions.question: What did their Lord invite them to after the test of worldly life?
questions.answer: He invited them to endless happiness and the Abode of Peace.

questions.question: What prayer is made at the end for the students of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: A prayer is made that Allah includes us among them.

questions.question: What did they say when they saw the signs of Allah’s greatness in the universe?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What two physical acts did they do after that?
questions.answer: They bowed and prostrated.

questions.question: What does asking only Allah for help teach about where true help comes from?
questions.answer: It teaches that real help comes from Allah alone.

questions.question: Why is Allah the only One they asked from?
questions.answer: Because He alone has complete richness and wide mercy.

questions.question: What did they do when Allah’s rule and oneness were made known throughout the universe?
questions.answer: They submitted and obeyed.

title: Reality of Prayer Reverence Reliance Oneness and the End of the Believers
